preconditions.description: The input integers R and C are within the range [1, 20].
The input contains exactly two space-separated integers.

postconditions.expression: all(c in 'LRUD' for c in stdout.strip())
postconditions.description: The output string consists only of the characters 'L', 'R', 'U', and 'D'.
The length of the output instruction sequence does not exceed 10,000.

postconditions.expression: len(set(final_pos(R, C, seq, ox, oy) for ox in range(1, R + 1) for oy in range(1, C + 1))) == R * C
postconditions.description: For the given sequence, every possible obstacle location (X, Y) within the bounds [1, R] x [1, C] results in a unique final robot position, allowing the obstacle to be uniquely determined.
